capabilities: attach context text to selected words or the word under the cursor
replace text inline or show the attached text in a popup
create and reuse custom context types and style presets
edit, remove, and navigate contexts with palette commands
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; flashcard scheduling, vault-wide search, and shared definitions are planned but not yet implemented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach hidden contextual text, such as translations or definitions, to ordinary words inside a note.
summary: Inline context tool that attaches translations, definitions, or other hidden text to words, shown by inline replacement or popup.
